That was created by Hog Hefner, right?
My wife’s Norwegian family love the joke “what’s one thing Sweden has that Norway doesn’t? Nice neighbors,” to which our Swedish friends say “yes, the Finns are lovely.”
It is sad. Up until now the Swedish Chef has been such an accurate depiction of Swedish culture and cuisine …

They’re opening a Swedish chef themed restaurant at Disney World. While this is welcome and long overdue, I hope there is at least some chance that my food could come to life and attack me. Otherwise, what’s the point?

One must imagine Sisyphus getting to the fireworks factory.

My 10-year-old on dinosaur chicken nuggets: They’re the best. Even if you don’t like dinos, you can just cut off the head, feet, and tails.  And then it’s like you defeated the dinosaurs.

Among the many things I find fascinating about this list is the fact that whoever assembled it put it in alphabetical order except for the last two, because apparently they thought it would be better to end with Wicked Alice rather than Wide-ass Nellie.
It’s weird, watching the Daredevil show and seeing Kingpin murder people with his bare hands and set heavily-armed maniacs against civilians, and knowing he’s still a better human being than Trump. ￼

Hey, Universe!

STOP KILLING THE WRONG OLD MEN! 

www.huffpost.com/entry/ted-tu...

Leslie Bibb is awesome and I would never want to body shame anybody, or question the choices they make for their own bodies, especially knowing the pressure that actresses feel to stay thin. But this is more carbohydrates than this woman has eaten since the Obama administration.
If I were a celebrity I would live in constant fear that I might get invited to the Met Gala.
Luke Skywalker is the ultimate Generation X icon because, like so many of us, he learned everything he needed to know from a Muppet.
RFK 100% thinks he saved somebody from being attacked by this starling.

Yeah, I think you nailed it. I mean, who else would we consider? John Goodman, Dan Lauria, Ray Romano, Tony Danza, Reginald VelJohnson, and the Modern Family dads seem like the only viable options and Gross tops any of them.

Who else would even be in the conversation? Neil Flynn? Bill Kirchenbauer?
Nuts! I only lived in NYC for one year under Giuliani. I’m gonna be so far back in line I’m gonna have to take bathroom breaks during my wait!
Upon reflection I would swap Friends and Star Trek: TNG for Head of the Class and maybe West Wing.
